pages.heading: Anteater
pages.body: Jungles. Neutral until attacked, then dangerous at close range. It eats Leafcutter Ants and digs into anthills, sometimes uncovering pupae, fungus, dirt

pages.heading: Anteater (cont.)
pages.body: and tubers. Breed with Leafcutter Ant Pupae. Keep it away from an ant colony you want to preserve.
